title: Fix VIP 10% discount, add height dropdown, and show delivery-time message on landing page

requirements.text: Make VIP status work end-to-end by ensuring the frontend VIP check reflects the same VIP source of truth that admins toggle in the backend (so a VIP user consistently receives the VIP experience and pricing).

quotes: Make sure VIP works make sure if they are it takes off %10 off order pricing

acceptanceCriteria: When an admin grants VIP to a user, that same user is recognized as VIP in the customer UI (without requiring manual hacks like clearing storage).
When an admin revokes VIP, the user is no longer recognized as VIP in the customer UI.
VIP status is consistent across backend endpoints and frontend hooks (no mismatch between profile.isVIP and backend VIP tracking).

requirements.text: Apply a 10% VIP discount to order pricing everywhere the user sees pricing for a new order (including the order pricing breakdown and the final total), using the existing VIP pricing logic.

quotes: Make sure VIP works make sure if they are it takes off %10 off order pricing

acceptanceCriteria: If the signed-in caller is VIP, the order form pricing section shows a line item for “VIP 10% Discount” and the total reflects 10% off the base order price.
If the signed-in caller is not VIP, no VIP discount line item is shown and the total equals the non-discounted pricing (plus/minus any other existing discounts already implemented).
The VIP discount amount equals exactly 10% of the base order price used by the app.

requirements.text: Change the height input on the new order form to a dropdown (select) for height selection.

quotes: also make it so for the height make a dropdrop for height selection

acceptanceCriteria: The height field on the new order form is a dropdown/select control instead of a freeform text input.
Submitting an order sends the selected height value through the existing create-order payload field for height.
Form validation and UX do not block selection-based height entry (i.e., dropdown values are considered valid inputs).

requirements.text: Add a visible “2–3 week Delivery time” message on the main (landing) page.

quotes: also put on main page 2-3 week Delivery time

acceptanceCriteria: The landing page displays the text “2–3 week Delivery time” in a clearly visible location (e.g., within the hero section).
The text is written in English exactly as “2–3 week Delivery time” (or “2–3 week delivery time” if styling requires capitalization consistency), and is not hidden behind interactions.

requirements.text: Fix any broken VIP- and order-related flows introduced by the above changes so that creating an order, viewing pricing, and toggling VIP as an admin work without runtime errors.
acceptanceCriteria: Creating an order works successfully for both VIP and non-VIP users.
No console errors occur during the VIP check, order creation, or when loading the landing page.
Admin VIP toggle actions complete without trapping/uncaught errors and the customer UI reflects the updated VIP state per REQ-1.

constraints: Backend must remain a single Motoko actor in backend/main.mo (no additional backend services).
Do not edit any files under frontend/src/components/ui (compose them instead).
Do not edit immutable hook/bootstrap files: frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx.
nonGoals: Implementing a full promo code system (backend validation/storage) beyond what already exists.
Changing product pricing beyond the requested VIP 10% discount behavior.
Adding new authentication providers (only Internet Identity is supported).
